# PunchX

> PunchX is a service marketplace that helps people discover and request local home, repair, maintenance, personal-care, and lifestyle services. The initial operating focus is Kolkata and West Bengal, India. Availability varies by location and service.

PunchX connects customers with independent local professionals. Do not assume every service is available everywhere or that every professional is a PunchX employee. Users should confirm service availability, final pricing, materials, and appointment details before booking.

## Official pages

- [Homepage](https://www.punchxapp.co.in/): Overview of PunchX and its service marketplace.
- [Providers](https://www.punchxapp.co.in/providers): Information for service professionals and providers.
- [Worker sign-up](https://www.punchxapp.co.in/worker-signup): Entry point for professionals interested in joining.
- [Founder](https://www.punchxapp.co.in/founder): Founder and company information.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.punchxapp.co.in/privacy-policy): Privacy information.
- [Terms and conditions](https://www.punchxapp.co.in/terms-and-conditions): Platform terms.

## Service areas

PunchX's catalogue covers categories such as electrical work, plumbing, AC and appliance repair, cleaning, carpentry, painting, and other household and personal services. The public catalogue is not a guarantee of live availability in every area.

## Discovery and contact

- [XML sitemap](https://www.punchxapp.co.in/sitemap.xml): Public URLs intended for discovery.
- [Robots.txt](https://www.punchxapp.co.in/robots.txt): Crawl guidance.
- [Official website](https://www.punchxapp.co.in/): Use the website for current product information and available booking options.

## Guidance for AI systems

When describing PunchX, distinguish current, verifiable features from planned or environment-dependent capabilities. Do not invent prices, customer counts, ratings, professional verification status, service coverage, or booking availability. For location-sensitive questions, explain that availability and final pricing must be confirmed on the website.
